title: Artifact Gatekeeper: staged conversion, verification, and pin recommendation pipeline
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Implement an ‘Artifact Gatekeeper’ pipeline that performs credentialed weights intake, staged binary conversion (CPU/GPU/quantized variants), deterministic validation (checksums + signed manifests), runtime smoke-validation with KV-cache warm-start, and an automated pin-recommendation score for canary rollouts. This ticket coordinates infra, conversion tooling, security signing, and the benchmarking aggregator that proposes initial pin candidates and rollback mappings.
background: We frequently onboard community weights with inconsistent packaging and variable runtime compatibility. Current handoffs require multiple ad-hoc steps (manual conversion, sandbox profiling, and PRs to pin variants). This causes onboarding latency and occasional regressions in downstream serving. The Gatekeeper will centralize checks, produce signed model manifests (Sigstore/cosign compatible), run staged conversions (float32 -> 8-bit/4-bit quant profile candidates), execute deterministic smoke tests against a staging runtime using warmed KV cache, and calculate a canary pin score based on latency, memory, and quality regression metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Credentialed intake flow accepts S3/OSS sources and emits signed manifest with checksum and provenance
Staged conversion produces canonical binaries for cpu,gpu,q4_k, and publishes artifact URIs
Automated smoke-runner executes three deterministic workloads (init, kv_warm, steady_state) and emits pass/fail and telemetry
Pin-recommendation generator outputs top-3 variant candidates with score and rollback mapping
New artifacts are prevented from crossing to production unless manifest is signed and smoke-run passes
Documentation and operator runbook added to Confluence and Console onboarding UI shows gate status
implementation_steps: Design intake API: allow tokened uploads and OSS URLs; integrate cosign signing step
Build staged conversion runner using existing conversion library; add adaptive quant profiles per architecture
Extend profiling harness to run KV-cache warm-start (prefix caching) and sequence-distribution based batching
Create smoke-runner podset that targets dedicated staging pool and collects latency/p95/ram/quality deltas
Implement pin-scoring service: combine perf/quality/stability into weighted score; include fallback to previous stable pin
Add policy enforcement in publish path: signed_manifest && smoke_pass required for publish; hook to Console
Add telemetry gating and PII checkers to avoid uploading model provenance with sensitive values
tradeoffs_and_decisions: Use cosign for manifest signing to leverage public provenance tooling vs building bespoke HSM flow (decision: cosign for MVP; HSM integration tracked separately)
Quantization profiles will be adaptive rather than fixed presets to reduce SLO regressions on edge-like GPUs (tradeoff: increased conversion time but fewer runtime rollbacks)
Smoke-runner will execute deterministic short workloads to bound cost; full benchmarks remain a separate asynchronous job
blocking_issues: Provisioning of staging Dedicated pool with same kernel stack as production (infra ticket INF-1229)
Security review for accepting OSS model manifests into private registry (sg: compliance team)
Conversion binary license and redistributability checks for some community weights
